stages.title: Set up the file
say: Spotify's style guide says a variable name is lowercase words joined by underscores that say what the variable holds. Capital letters count, so `play_count` and `Play_Count` are two different variables.
stages.type: Make the **first line** of the file a comment that starts with `# PURPOSE:` and says, in at least five words, what this program is for.
chk: a PURPOSE comment of five or more words

artist_name = "The Weeknd"
play_count = 4000000
length_seconds = 200
rating = 4.8
top_song = "Flowers"
